header.title: AutoAnimateContainer
header.description: Animates the host width and/or height when the inner content resizes. There is no presence flag (`isIn`): it measures the surface, interpolates from the previous size, then settles on `auto`. Use it for panels, tabs, detail alerts or chips whose label changes length.

callbacks.title: Events
callbacks.description: `onAutoAnimate` fires when the container is active (on mount or when enabled, `reason: "enter"`) and `outAutoAnimate` when it is disabled (`disabled`) or unmounted (`unmount`). It does not fire on every resize — it is the host lifecycle, not each animation.

header.title: AutoAnimateContainer API
header.description: Props, inheritance, accessibility, CSS classes and variables, and exported types for `AutoAnimateContainer`.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: Playground and examples for every axis, overflow and option.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import it from `@gem-org/gemsitions/auto-animate-container` with its `auto-animate-container.css`, or from the root if you already load `styles.css`.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Accepts HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> and forwards them to the root div, or to the child with asChild. In that case classes and styles merge with the child's and, when both define the same handler, the child's runs first. The component handles onTransitionEnd internally and then calls yours.

items.noPresence: There is no presence flag: whatever you mount is what gets measured. If size conveys information, also expose it in text or ARIA attributes.
items.reducedMotion: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the host snaps to the final size. The preference is read on every render, not listened to live.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: ignoreReducedMotion keeps the animation and adds the gemst-ignore-reduced-motion class to the root. Use it only when motion is essential.
items.overflow: While animating, host overflow clips in-flow content so it does not race ahead of the box. With visible, outer shadows stay visible; inner content still clips to the interpolating box.
items.asChild: With asChild, pick a child with the right semantics (Card, section, aside): the observer measures that element, including nested padding.

items.root: Root (`div`). `box-sizing: border-box` and `color: inherit`. With `axis="height"` it is a full-width `block`; with `width` / `both` it is `inline-block`.
items.axis: Active axis. Controls how the host and surface are sized.
items.overflow: Overflow while animating. When settled (`--settled`) it returns to `visible`.
items.animateOpacity: Enables the surface fade during the resize.
items.animating: While size is interpolating. Enables the `width` / `height` transition.
items.settled: No animation running and size is `auto`. Sets `overflow: visible`.
items.surface: Inner `div` wrapping the content (without `asChild`). During the resize it locks to the host box so it does not race ahead.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: Written inline on every render (as `0ms` with `isDisabled` or reduced motion). Used by the size transition (and opacity when `animateOpacity` is on).

items.duration: Duration of the current phase (grow = `enter`, shrink = `exit`). Default `300ms`.
items.delay: Delay of the current phase. Default `0ms`.
items.easing: Curve of the current phase. Default `standard`.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: Global gemsitions variables the CSS uses as defaults.

items.easingStandard: Default for `--gemst-auto-animate-easing`. The component writes the resolved curve inline, so redefining the token does not change the animation: use `easing`.

content.title: Content
content.description: What is measured and where it mounts.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Axes, overflow while resizing and optional fade.

timing.title: Timing
timing.description: In milliseconds. `enter` applies to grow and `exit` to shrink.

state.title: State
state.description: How the animation is turned off.

items.children: Content whose size animates the host. Without `asChild` it is wrapped in the surface.
items.asChild: Applies classes, styles and ref to the single child. ResizeObserver watches that host; nested padding is included in the natural measure.
items.axis: `height` (default) is a full-width block; `width` and `both` size to content (`inline-block`).
items.overflow: Host overflow while animating. Default `hidden`. `visible` keeps outer shadows; `clip` clips without creating a scroll container. When settled it always returns to `visible`.
items.animateOpacity: Fades the surface while size changes. Softens panel swaps.
items.duration: Duration. With `{ enter, exit }`, `enter` is grow and `exit` is shrink.
items.delay: Wait before starting. Accepts `{ enter, exit }` like `duration`.
items.easing: Token (`standard`, `enter`, `exit`, `emphasized`, `linear`), a CSS timing function or `{ enter, exit }`. Default `standard`.
items.isDisabled: Snaps to the new size with no interpolation. Turning it on sends `disabled` to `outAutoAnimate`.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: Animates even when the user prefers reduced motion. Only when essential.
items.onAutoAnimate: Fires when the container is active: on mount or when enabled (`reason: "enter"`).
items.style: Inline styles for the root. Merged with the animated size and the `--gemst-auto-animate-*` variables.
items.ref: Ref to the root (the `div`, or the child with `asChild`).
